verified: Bloomberg's Yuan Gao reported that Lenovo's September-quarter revenue rose 48% year over year to $30.2 billion, above estimates, and that the company posted a $640 million net loss and its first operating loss since 2017.
unconfirmed: The size of the accounting charges versus the component-cost impact, the segment breakdown, and whether the $38 million consensus figure was an expected loss or an expected profit; these rest on the Bloomberg account alone, with no primary filing cited.

verified: 据彭博报道，联想截至9月的季度营收为302亿美元、同比增长48%，净亏损6.4亿美元，并录得2017年以来首次营业亏损；彭博将亏损与会计费用及PC组件成本上升联系起来。
unconfirmed: 彭博摘要未拆解会计费用的具体构成，也未说明3800万美元的“预期”指亏损还是利润；联想的正式财报文件细节不在报道中。

titles.en: Lenovo posts $640M net loss as PC component costs bite despite 48% revenue growth
titles.zh: 联想营收增48%仍净亏6.4亿美元，为2017年来首次营业亏损
